'''Kymber Black''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] living on [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was married to [[Thadius Black]]. When Thadius Black arranged to smuggle political prisoners off world during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he smuggled Kymber Black and their infant son out as well.<ref name="I" />
